title: Flame and Blame
pitch: Co-op chaotic firefighters on Roblox: alarm, burning town block, hose, axe, rescues, Blame awards.
core_loop: Lobby at Station 67 -> alarm -> teleport to the Town -> hose spreading fires, axe locked doors, carry civilians and pets to truck 67 -> 3-minute timer -> Blame results -> back to the station.

modules.purpose: New server service (ModuleScript) that ServerScriptService/Main.server.luau boots automatically; edit no other file. Return a table FlareUpService with Priority = 60; Init(self, services) only stores the services table (no calls, no yields); Start(self) starts ONE task.spawn loop; _selftest(self): (boolean, string) returns true, "ok". Loop: every 8 seconds, while workspace:GetAttribute("RoundState") == "Active", take id = workspace:GetAttribute("MissionId"), pick a part with services.MapService:RandomFlammable(id, rng) (rng = Random.new(os.time())) and call services.FireService:Ignite(part, nil); when Ignite returns true, call require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry")).count("flareups", 1). Nil-guard services.MapService and services.FireService (peers can be missing). Use task.wait, never wait(); create no Instances.

acceptance: During an Active round, flare-ups ignite new fires in the Town (ForgeProbe counter flareups > 0)
No errors or [Boot] warnings in the ForgeProbe report
FlareUpService boots without any other file being edited
